items.title: Homomorphisms out of a finitely presented module commute with filtered colimits
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the sheaf of homomorphisms out of a finitely presented module into a filtered colimit of modules is the colimit of the sheaves of homomorphisms into the terms (author lemma at source lines 3975-3987, label lemma-hom-finite-presentation-colimit). The proof (source lines 3989-4032) reduces to a module with a global presentation, writes the exact sequences for the module and for each term using the behaviour of the sheaf of homomorphisms on finite direct sums and its exactness in the first variable, and then compares the colimit of the first with the second, using exactness of filtered colimits and the fact that the outer arrows are colimits of identities (proof lines 4004-4031). The comparison of the two exact sequences is the content. H2.
